column2: Fixed: resolved steps now set runtime.workingDir to ctx.root so checks execute in the project directory.
Fixed: synthesizeCheckSteps now returns ResolvedCheck[] and preserves resolver outputs for findings extraction.
Fixed: shell command arguments are individually quoted before joining, preventing unsafe space-join behavior.
Fixed: synthesis now preserves ResolvedCheck.outputs instead of discarding them.
Fixed: deduplication and the generated step ID both use resolved.checkId consistently (checks/${resolved.checkId}).
Fixed: shell command args are safely quoted and runtime.workingDir is set to ctx.root.
Fixed: synthesizeCheckSteps preserves outputs and uses the same resolved.checkId for dedup and step id.
